parsed.rationale: Both participating records have is_test=true: `makePlaycut` in `NowPlayingInfoCenterManagerTests.swift` and `makeTestPlaycut` in `NowPlayingWidgetTests.swift` are test-only factory helpers. Although the Jaccard similarity of 0.818 suggests structural overlap, test fixture builders are routinely duplicated per test file to keep each test suite self-contained and readable. Consolidating them into a shared helper would couple unrelated test suites and obscure the intent of each fixture. Per the decision rules, all-test clusters default to no-action.
